review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 登场与随后授印时序、PP保护优先级、异常执行前木印快照及奖励抽样均按已答落实。
review.singleBehavior: 登场双方授四种5回印记，仅清除一次三项；成功项数指定五种无放回独立公共时长，失败异常数累计无效，清除失败魂印回100。金印首清后授不护本次、已有保原值至多5、先其他保护；木印按最终低概率原正数授予并仅挡后续；红伤免疫/减伤归零授火土，纯盾/MISS不授，火土唯一最高抗性100及穿减50保留。
review.deferredBehavior: 本人真正场下存活于出战背包时观察己方队友PP清空/攻击归零、敌方场下指定；水印取消真实场下目标指定；真实队伍共享印记/跨换宠保留与移交；真正再次登场重复入场授印与一次奖励。当前自己/对手在场可触发金木火土、授四印与三项清除全部已实现。

success.name: 4930火土印记红伤免疫归零授予且不结算第二次登场奖励，已有同种不重复种类；纯盾与MISS不触发
success.assertion: test('4930火土印记红伤免疫归零授予且不结算第二次登场奖励，已有同种不重复种类；纯盾与MISS不触发',()=>{for(const existing of[false,true]){const s=partialMake({move:38485,index:1});if(existing)mark(s,1,'火土');timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,38485,20117);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.fiveMarks2125.火土.end,5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperorEntryRewards2125,undefined);}for(const mode of['shield','miss']){const p=partialMake({move:38485,index:1,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='shield')S.refresh(p.fighters[1],9000,'test');else timer(p,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});turn(p,38485,20117);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.fiveMarks2125.火土,undefined);}});

success.name: 4930火土提升唯一最高异常抗性到100，平手及0不提；忽略50%攻击减伤仍不越过攻击免疫
success.assertion: test('4930火土提升唯一最高异常抗性到100，平手及0不提；忽略50%攻击减伤仍不越过攻击免疫',()=>{for(const chances of[[55,18],[50,50],[0,0]]){const s=make({move:38485,index:1});mark(s,0,'火土');s.fighters[0].build.resistance.slots=[{name:'中毒',chance:chances[0]},{name:'烧伤',chance:chances[1]},{name:'',chance:0}];assert.equal(E.GEAR.resistanceChance(s.fighters[0],'中毒'),chances[0]>chances[1]?1:chances[0]/100);assert.equal(E.GEAR.resistanceChance(s.fighters[0],'烧伤'),chances[1]/100);}const s=make({move:38485,index:1}),z=make({move:38485,index:1});mark(s,0,'火土');timer(s,1,'攻击伤害减免',{fraction:.5});timer(z,1,'攻击伤害减免',{fraction:.5});turn(s,38485,20117);turn(z,38485,20117);assert.ok(sum(s)>sum(z));const p=make({move:38485,index:1});mark(p,0,'火土');timer(p,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(p,38485,20117);assert.equal(sum(p),0);});

success.name: 4930三项清除失败各100魂印回复且技能禁疗不阻，成功项实际消除并从五种中无放回附异常
success.assertion: test('4930三项清除失败各100魂印回复且技能禁疗不阻，成功项实际消除并从五种中无放回附异常',()=>{const s=partialMake({move:38485,index:1,hp:5000});s.fighters[1].effects={};for(const n of['金','木','水'])mark(s,0,n);timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)E.SOULS.registry[2125].abilities.entryRewards(c);},()=>turn(s,38485,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,5300);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperorCleanup2125.map(x=>x.success),[false,false,false]);const p=partialMake({move:38485,index:1,hp:5000});mark(p,0,'金');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)E.SOULS.registry[2125].abilities.entryRewards(c);},()=>turn(p,38485,20117));assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.emperorCleanup2125[0].success,true);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.emperorEntryRewards2125[0].draws.length,1);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].hp,5000);});

success.name: 4930已答真实登场直接四种五回印记，超过三种仅三项清除，之后新印记不再结算奖励
success.assertion: test('4930已答真实登场直接四种五回印记，超过三种仅三项清除，之后新印记不再结算奖励',()=>{const s=entry(0),a=s.fighters[0],b=s.fighters[1];assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(a.soulState.fiveMarks2125),['金','火土']);assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(b.soulState.fiveMarks2125),['木','水']);for(const f of [a,b])for(const e of Object.values(f.soulState.fiveMarks2125))assert.deepEqual([e.start,e.end,e.sourceHash],[1,5,'4c65a1e0']);assert.deepEqual(a.soulState.emperorCleanup2125.map(x=>x.success),[false,false,false]);assert.equal(a.hp,5300);assert.equal(a.soulState.emperorEntryRewards2125.length,1);delete a.soulState.fiveMarks2125.火土;timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');timer(s,1,'entryLater');b.stages.def=2;a.ailments['凝滞']=5;turn(s,38485,20020);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.fiveMarks2125.火土.end,5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperorEntryRewards2125.length,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].effects.entryLater);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['凝滞']);});

success.name: 4930已答登场按成功项数从指定五种无放回抽，免疫不补抽，未附加次数累加技能无效且消费PP
success.assertion: test('4930已答登场按成功项数从指定五种无放回抽，免疫不补抽，未附加次数累加技能无效且消费PP',()=>{const seen=new Set();for(let n=0;n<=3;n++)for(const immune of [0,3]){const s=entry(n,immune),a=s.fighters[0],b=s.fighters[1],out=a.soulState.emperorEntryRewards2125[0];assert.deepEqual(a.soulState.emperorCleanup2125.map(x=>x.success),[0,1,2].map(i=>i<n));assert.equal(out.draws.length,n);assert.equal(new Set(out.draws.map(x=>x.status)).size,n);for(const d of out.draws){assert.ok(['麻痹','感染','冰封','焚烬','石化'].includes(d.status));seen.add(d.status);assert.equal(d.applied,immune===0);if(d.applied)assert.ok([2,3].includes(b.ailments[d.status]));}assert.equal(a.hp,5000+(3-n)*100);assert.equal(out.failed,immune?n:0);assert.equal(b.effects['帝皇清除奖励技能无效']?.end,immune&&n?n:undefined);if(immune&&n){const pp=b.pp[key(20570)];turn(s,38485,20570);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[key(20570)],pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState?.actionEndedRound,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,0);}}assert.ok(seen.size>=3);});

success.name: 4930已答金印首次清空不保护该次，已有低PP保原值，先其他PP保护，正常消耗归零不授印
success.assertion: test('4930已答金印首次清空不保护该次，已有低PP保原值，先其他PP保护，正常消耗归零不授印',()=>{for(const initial of [0,1,4,5,9]){const s=partialMake(opts),a=s.fighters[0],k=a.moves[1];a.pp[k]=initial;const x=P.clear2125(a,k,1);assert.equal(x.after,0);assert.equal(x.cleared,initial>0);assert.equal(!!a.soulState.fiveMarks2125.金,initial>0);if(initial){a.pp[k]=initial;assert.equal(P.clear2125(a,k,2).after,Math.min(initial,5));assert.equal(a.soulState.fiveMarks2125.金.end,6);}}for(const floor of [2,7]){const s=partialMake(opts),a=s.fighters[0],k=a.moves[1];a.pp[k]=9;P.protectReduction(a,floor);P.clear2125(a,k,1);assert.equal(a.pp[k],floor);assert.equal(a.soulState.fiveMarks2125.金,undefined);mark(s,0,'金',5);P.clear2125(a,k,2);assert.equal(a.pp[k],floor);}const s=partialMake(opts);timer(s,0,'PP保护');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.clearPP(c.t,c.t.moves[1]);},()=>turn(s,38485,20570));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[s.fighters[0].moves[1]],s.moveDefinitions[s.fighters[0].moves[1]].pp);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.fiveMarks2125.金,undefined);const q=partialMake(opts);q.fighters[0].pp[key(38485)]=1;turn(q,38485,20570);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].pp[key(38485)],0);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].soulState.fiveMarks2125.金,undefined);});

success.name: 4930已答新木印不挡首发自然10%异常，后续执行拦截并刷新；100%仍附加
success.assertion: test('4930已答新木印不挡首发自然10%异常，后续执行拦截并刷新；100%仍附加',()=>{let succeeded=0;for(let seed=1;seed<=96;seed++){const s=partialMake({...opts,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,38485,10114);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.fiveMarks2125.木.end,5);if(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'])succeeded++;delete s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'];turn(s,38485,10114);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.fiveMarks2125.木.end,6);}assert.ok(succeeded>0&&succeeded<96);const s=make(opts);turn(s,38485,20020);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']);});

success.name: 4930已答木印按最终概率不高于50且原始正数判断，原始零不执行，封零仍授印，判定与附加不重入
success.assertion: test('4930已答木印按最终概率不高于50且原始正数判断，原始零不执行，封零仍授印，判定与附加不重入',()=>{for(const [original,modified,locked,grant,apply]of[[0,0,false,false,false],[60,40,false,true,true],[40,60,false,false,true],[10,10,true,true,false],[10,10,false,true,true]]){const s=partialMake(opts);if(locked)s.fighters[1].soulState.bright2009=1;let result;observe((e,c)=>{if(e!=='beforeUse'||c.a.side!==1)return;const pass=c.ailmentRoll4853(original,0,{originalChance:original,modifiedChance:modified});result=pass<modified/100&&c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:modified});},()=>turn(s,38485,20570));assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].soulState.fiveMarks2125?.木,grant,[original,modified,locked].join());assert.equal(!!result,apply);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],apply);}});

success.assertion: test('4930已答2527双方全部印记剩余回合先合计再除五取整，过期排除，真实登场20回合授四回免粉',()=>{const row=H.source.moves.flatMap(m=>m.effectInstances.map((e,index)=>({move:m.id,index,id:e.id}))).find(e=>e.id===2527);for(const ends of [[2,3],[3,3],[1,3],[0,5]]){const s=make(row);mark(s,0,'金',ends[0]);mark(s,1,'水',ends[1]);let granted;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterHit'&&c.a.side===0)granted=c.a.effects['帝皇印记固粉免疫']?.end;},()=>turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117));const n=Math.floor(ends.reduce((n,x)=>n+Math.max(0,x),0)/5);assert.equal(granted,n?n:undefined);}const s=make({...row,soul:true});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,10716);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['帝皇印记固粉免疫'].end,4);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed',1),0);});

success.assertion: test('4930已答指定五种候选等宽抽样、独立2或3回，无效持续按未附加数到期且不缩短其他来源封锁',()=>{const pool=['麻痹','感染','冰封','焚烬','石化'];for(let i=0;i<5;i++){const s=entry(1,0,()=>i/5+.01),draw=s.fighters[0].soulState.emperorEntryRewards2125[0].draws;assert.deepEqual(draw.map(x=>x.status),[pool[i]]);assert.ok([2,3].includes(s.fighters[1].ailments[pool[i]]));}for(let n=1;n<=3;n++){const s=entry(n,3);for(let r=1;r<=n;r++){turn(s,38485,20570);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[key(20570)],s.moveDefinitions[key(20570)].pp-r);}turn(s,38485,20570);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,1);}const s=entry(3,3);timer(s,1,'skillBlock',{},1,8);for(let i=0;i<4;i++)turn(s,38485,20570);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects.skillBlock.end,8);});

interaction.name: 4930已答金印首次清空不保护该次，已有低PP保原值，先其他PP保护，正常消耗归零不授印
interaction.assertion: test('4930已答金印首次清空不保护该次，已有低PP保原值，先其他PP保护，正常消耗归零不授印',()=>{for(const initial of [0,1,4,5,9]){const s=partialMake(opts),a=s.fighters[0],k=a.moves[1];a.pp[k]=initial;const x=P.clear2125(a,k,1);assert.equal(x.after,0);assert.equal(x.cleared,initial>0);assert.equal(!!a.soulState.fiveMarks2125.金,initial>0);if(initial){a.pp[k]=initial;assert.equal(P.clear2125(a,k,2).after,Math.min(initial,5));assert.equal(a.soulState.fiveMarks2125.金.end,6);}}for(const floor of [2,7]){const s=partialMake(opts),a=s.fighters[0],k=a.moves[1];a.pp[k]=9;P.protectReduction(a,floor);P.clear2125(a,k,1);assert.equal(a.pp[k],floor);assert.equal(a.soulState.fiveMarks2125.金,undefined);mark(s,0,'金',5);P.clear2125(a,k,2);assert.equal(a.pp[k],floor);}const s=partialMake(opts);timer(s,0,'PP保护');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.clearPP(c.t,c.t.moves[1]);},()=>turn(s,38485,20570));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[s.fighters[0].moves[1]],s.moveDefinitions[s.fighters[0].moves[1]].pp);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.fiveMarks2125.金,undefined);const q=partialMake(opts);q.fighters[0].pp[key(38485)]=1;turn(q,38485,20570);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].pp[key(38485)],0);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].soulState.fiveMarks2125.金,undefined);});
